exposition_seal.compressed_statement: At one deterministic location x and under the original unconditioned full Gaussian coefficient law, all scalar radial levels have joint law ⊗ᵢ N(0,n Cᵢ(x)²vᵢ). The factors are mutually independent and may be point masses.

STANDING: The isolated identity holds for positive n and natural h without the source's hard-family depth schedule, without extending admissibility or the lower-bound regime.

No nonzero tail or positive variance premise.

lossless_expansion.formula: At fixed x each Tᵢ is constant zero or a finite linear coefficient map. The product of group maps sends ⊗ᵢνᵢ to ⊗ᵢ(Tᵢ)₍#₎νᵢ. The source's independent scalar degree laws motivate grouping; the Lean proof groups actual coefficients first.
The evaluated group agrees with the actual radial marginal under the original law, so (Tᵢ)₍#₎νᵢ = N(0,n Cᵢ(x)²∑ₚ aᵢₚ²), including N(0,0)=δ₀. Insert these factors to obtain the exact joint law.
